The next sentence distinguishes amorphous solids from this long-range periodic arrangement without claiming that amorphous and periodic are the only possible categories. The ions-in-salt/atoms-in-diamond-and-magnesium distinction and the conditional geometric-face statement remain unchanged and compatible with the scoped sentence.
